integrity: Derived from precise finite-dimensional Gram reduction and standard, explicitly specified multivariate central limit theorems. Reproducibility computations corroborate finite identities and are not substitutes for infinite-dimensional proofs. No independent audit or certification has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Fixed sample size \(n\ge2\) with dimension tending to infinity; no jointly growing n,d theorem or general minimax bound.
The exact finite-dimensional beta/binomial power is for \(n=2\) only.
The alternative is discrete and mutually singular to Haar; the power limitation is specific to the quadratic maximal-projection statistic.
The separately published 2026 journal printing was inspected bibliographically/through abstract but its full body was not compared line by line; historical priority remains qualified.
title: A fixed-sample spectral limit and a sharp cube-bias threshold for spherical maximal-projection uniformity testing
